label: PADCLAMP_RETEST
note: RE-TEST. 67.1% of the gap is delivery-limited (car >10 km/h below its OWN target) and the one measured delivery defect is the c_ubyte wrap destroying 20.4% of the pedal, now confirmed from the device byte. The 08-02 arm scored 30.62 with 8 stalls and 4.25% off-track, but it ran from a freshly restored map immediately after a restart while the learner was re-carving, and an 18-min clamp-on window on 08-02 evening showed off-track 0.60% vs 0.52% and sideslip p99 8.30 vs 7.90, i.e. no destabilisation at all. pad_thr now verifies the clamp is actually applied.
